payload.text: **A CLAIM IS ABOUT ITS CORPUS, AND A SESSION'S HOOKS LIVE IN TWO FILES** (2026-09-17). My all-clear for the rebuild hold said no hook opens the store, after reading .claude/settings.json alone. .claude/settings.local.json wires post-tool-symbol-context, which runs `intent search --context` after a single-symbol grep, and vc and dc caught it. List .claude/settings*.json before judging what a session's hooks do, and name the files read inside the claim.
